content:
sam_marketing: Quick thread 1: need a one-page battlecard + webinar blurb focused on competitive messaging vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, and infra vendors. Theme: 'Serving-first economics' 1.

kate_research: Dropping sanitized bench highlight (internal):
Workload: multi-turn chat, avg session ~350 tokens
Testbed: eu-west-1, A100-class equiv, steady-state ~70% util
Redwood: p95 ~105ms, cost/convo ~$0.016
CloudManaged: p95 ~220ms, cost/convo ~$0.042
Self-host baseline: p95 ~300ms (degrades under burst), cost/convo ~$0.028

jun_sales: I'll draft SDR one-pager and two procurement rebuttals. Need a 1M conv/mo ROI example from Kate to include numbers.

rachel_content: Draft hero for landing: "Serve LLMs predictably 1 lower p95, clearer unit economics, automatic fallbacks." Short social variant: "Predictable inference. Lower tail latency. Clearer economics." Thoughts?

kate_research: ROI quick calc (illustrative): 1M conv/mo -> Redwood ~$16k/mo, CloudManaged ~$42k/mo, delta ~$26k/mo (~$312k/yr). Mark internal.

sam_marketing: Owners and deadlines: Jun -> SDR one-pager + rebuttals by EOD; Rachel -> hero + slide blurb by noon; Kate -> sanitized table + short methodology line by 3pm. I'll assemble deck and run a 10m dry-run tomorrow.

jun_sales: On it. Also adding routing suggestion: registration poll (latency/cost/compliance) -> route to SDR/SDR/solutions-eng respectively. Wire into webhook at /webhooks/registrations.

webhook_bot: registration-webhook endpoint available (internal).

sam_marketing: Keep public copy conservative: use "in our tests" and relative phrasing ("~2x lower p95 vs CloudManaged in our tests"). Label slides "internal" until legal reviews. Thanks team. (END)
